Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the 5-hydroxytryptamine receptor 2A (CHEMBL224). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary, filtering by target chembl_id CHEMBL224 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical SMILES. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
